basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer living in Riga, Latvia. I enjoy spending my afternoons diving into comic books and exploring new names for my future plans of having a family. I'm an introvert, so I relish quiet evenings with a good book or a classic movie. While I love my job in the creative field, I occasionally dabble in community theater as a hobby. I'm currently single and spend most of my online time in the evenings, especially after 8 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I studied graphic design at a local arts college and have been working in the field for the past five years. My passion for theater comes from childhood experiences, and I keep up with graphic design trends through self-taught online courses and forums.
